verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a hosted AI app builder like v0, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage-tracking controls, data-sharing settings or a training opt-out. The docs cover GitHub, deployments, projects, pricing and the API, and none of those are about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
